institutions.name: Guka and Cucu Coffee Farm
institutions.description: Farm-to-cup coffee retail and intimate, advance-booked day experiences at Guka and Cucu’s farm in Kabati, Murang’a. The official site advertises hands-on coffee activities, farm-to-table lunch and rooftop sundowners. Overnight stays are not yet offered.

institutions.name: Gatura Greens
institutions.description: Purple-tea farm tourism with hands-on tea picking, processing and tasting, bamboo-forest/waterfall activities and lunch, plus country-house and camping accommodation. Its linked BREW IT shop sells packaged teas and soaps.

institutions.name: Kakuzi PLC
institutions.description: Agricultural grower with avocado, macadamia, blueberry, forestry, livestock and tea operations. Its official report confirms domestic sales at Kakuzi Farm Market of ready-to-eat macadamia nuts, cold-pressed macadamia oil, avocados, blueberries and loose-leaf tea. Retail prices require enquiry; no public farm-tour service was verified.

institutions.name: Rapids Camp Sagana
institutions.description: Adventure camp selling individual and customised group activities, corporate team-building, camping and room accommodation, meals and visitor-transfer logistics. Public deals combine activities and accommodation; undated promotional prices require reconfirmation.

institutions.name: Tamarind Mombasa
institutions.description: Seafood restaurant and group/private dining on Mombasa’s waterfront. The current official Tamarind Dhow page describes a restored dhow moored at Tudor Creek for dining and private functions; it does not establish the old seeded sunset-cruise package or its price.

institutions.name: Bombolulu Workshops & Cultural Centre
institutions.description: APDK social-enterprise workshop supporting artisans with disabilities through training and employment, handmade-product retail and a visitor cultural centre with performances, traditional homesteads and a showroom.

institutions.name: Akamba Handicraft
institutions.description: Cooperative manufacturer and exporter of wood carvings and customised decorative goods. The official catalogue lists six product categories and uses an enquiry-led sales model. No separate paid workshop tour was verified on the official page.

institutions.name: Murang’a University of Technology
institutions.description: University providing undergraduate, postgraduate and TVET education through admissions and published fee structures, including online/blended learning links. Its mission also includes research, innovation, consultancy and community engagement. Previously seeded short-course prices and conference-hall rental were not verified.
